summary_en: Kamgras 1 K.K. extends tender offer period for Kakaku.com Inc. (2371) to 2026-07-22 (50 business days cumulative from May 13). Extension filed 2026-07-07 following target company's revised recommendation announcement.
title_en: Notice Regarding Extension of Tender Offer Period for Kakaku.com Inc. (Securities Code 2371) Conducted by Kamgras 1 K.K.
translation_en_brief: Kamgras 1 K.K., the tender offeror in the ongoing take-private of Kakaku.com Inc. (TSE Prime Market, code 2371), announced on 2026-07-07 an extension of the tender offer period to 2026-07-22 (10 business days from the date of filing a supplemental tender offer statement). The cumulative period is now 50 business days from the original start date of 2026-05-13. The extension was triggered by the target company's publication on 2026-07-02 of a partial revision to its recommendation statement and solicitation notice. The offeror states the extension is intended to provide shareholders and warrant holders with an additional opportunity to form a judgment and to increase the likelihood of offer success. Prior to this extension, the offeror had already extended the period from an originally scheduled 2026-07-16 close (47 business days) on 2026-07-02.
